quiz.question: Which major bank recently restricted its operations allowing customers to withdraw only Rs 5,000 as per RBI guidelines?
quiz.explanation: RBI ने पुडुचेरी को-ऑपरेटिव्ह अर्बन बँकेवर अनेक निर्बंध लादले आहेत, ज्यामध्ये आर्थिक स्थैर्य राखण्यासाठी ग्राहकांना जास्तीत जास्त ५,००० रुपये काढण्याची मर्यादा निश्चित केली आहे.

quiz.question: Who has been recently given the additional charge as the acting chairperson of the Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC)?
quiz.explanation: पेपरफुटी प्रकरणाच्या चौकशीच्या पार्श्वभूमीवर विवेक भीमनवार रजेवर गेल्यानंतर सतीश वाघोले यांच्याकडे MPSC च्या प्रभारी अध्यक्षपदाचा अतिरिक्त कार्यभार सोपवण्यात आला आहे.

quiz.question: Which recent Supreme Court action halted the urban local body elections in a southern Indian state?
options: कर्नाटक जिल्हा परिषद निवडणुका पुढे ढकलल्या
quiz.explanation: सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाने एक आदेश जारी करून आंध्र प्रदेशातील शहरी स्थानिक स्वराज्य संस्थांच्या निवडणुकांना तात्पुरती स्थगिती दिली आणि ७२ प्रभागांमध्ये पुन्हा उमेदवारी अर्ज भरण्याची प्रक्रिया सुरू केली.

quiz.question: Which country recently defeated New Zealand in a T20 match where Sanju Samson scored a crucial half-century?

quiz.question: How much gold reserves are currently held within India out of the RBI's total 880.52 tonnes according to recent reports?

quiz.question: Which infrastructure project was recently inaugurated by the Maharashtra Chief Minister in Mumbai to ease traffic congestion and reduce cross-city travel time?

quiz.question: What is the significant instruction recently given by the Maharashtra state government regarding expenditure across all departments?

quiz.question: The Supreme Court recently asked the Centre and the Election Commission for a response on a petition challenging a provision related to what?
quiz.explanation: निवडणूक आयुक्तांना देण्यात आलेल्या कायदेशीर संरक्षणाला आव्हान देणाऱ्या याचिकेवर सर्वोच्च न्यायालयाने केंद्र सरकार आणि निवडणूक आयोगाकडून उत्तर मागितले आहे.

quiz.question: Which important test for the Gaganyaan Programme was recently successfully completed by ISRO?

quiz.question: Who was appointed as the new Governor of Uttarakhand who recently met with Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
